name: Variational Compression of Implicit Neural Representations (VC-INR)
aliases: Variational Compression of Implicit Neural Representations
definition: A modality-agnostic neural compression algorithm based on a functional view of data parameterized as an Implicit Neural Representation (INR). It bridges the gap between latent coding and sparsity by obtaining compact latent representations non-linearly mapped to a soft gating mechanism, allowing the specialization of a shared INR network to each data item through subnetwork selection.
summary: VC-INR is a modality-agnostic neural compression algorithm that compresses data by parameterizing it as an Implicit Neural Representation and applying non-linear transform coding to its compact latent representation.
